about.text: Celebrating 10 years of delivering chef-crafted meals to happy customers across the country

We believe that cooking is one of life's greatest pleasures, but we also understand that finding the time and inspiration to cook can be challenging. That's why we're committed to making home cooking accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable for everyone.
We source the freshest ingredients directly from local farms and trusted suppliers, ensuring every meal meets our high standards.
We're proud to be a carbon-neutral company, using eco-friendly packaging and minimizing food waste throughout our operations.
Your satisfaction is our priority. We continuously improve our recipes and service based on customer feedback.
We support local communities through food donation programs and partnerships with food banks across the country.

FreshPlate started in 2013 with a simple idea: make restaurant-quality meals accessible to busy families and individuals. Our founder, Sarah Chen, a former executive chef, noticed how many people wanted to cook delicious, healthy meals but struggled with meal planning, grocery shopping, and recipe complexity.

What began as a small operation serving 50 families in New York City has grown into the nation's leading meal delivery service, serving millions of customers across all 50 states. Despite our growth, we've stayed true to our original mission: delivering chef-designed recipes and fresh ingredients that make home cooking easy and enjoyable.
Today, our team of 50+ chefs continues to innovate, creating new recipes each week while maintaining the quality and consistency that our customers have come to expect.
Former executive chef with 15+ years of experience in fine dining. Passionate about making gourmet cooking accessible to everyone.
James Beard Award-winning chef specializing in global cuisine. Leads our recipe development team.
Registered dietitian ensuring all meals meet nutritional standards while maintaining incredible flavor.
Join millions of home cooks who trust us to deliver quality, convenience, and culinary inspiration.
